governing_product_spec.meaning: Owner specification takes precedence over the book in current product. First region11/12, pocket absorption, six unnumbered Myth POIs, 24 individual internal-edge obstacles and manual no-rebalance are documented product choices. Source-profile shortfalls below are not automatically product bugs or authorization to change.

source_scope.realm_sheets: Official free snapshot2026-11-08, sha2566082a760c7db9b81baf0180cae585feb35826b24e5feb839434c4ff33deb924d, bounded PDF1 extraction; referenced bookp14 not independently read
source_scope.quickstart: Official free pinned snapshot, printed/PDFp14 Breaking the Rules and Wilderness/Barriers; typical recommendations explicitly overridable
limitations: Research acceptance includes product operationalizations, not only literal source requirements.
No changes to code, registry, backlog, ratings, main, GitHub or automation made by this audit.

findings.source_rule: Groups of d12 hexes sharing terrain type; research translates into chosen profile/type, exact size with adequate space, validation and persistence.
implemented: Uniform d12 targets1..12 after the first region; twelve midpoint bins probe returns1..12.
Single biomeId/biomeLandType is stored on each generated region; ordinary fresh-region probes target1/7/12 reached actual1/7/12.
Generation stores targetSize separately from finalSize; same map restored by undo/redo and save validation in current seeded tests.
Classic branch retains its supplied size procedure; switching mode does not rebuild existing regions.
partial_or_absent: First kingdom region deliberately uses11/12, not all d12 outcomes.
Enclosed pockets can increase final size beyond target; source's exact-count operational criterion is not universally satisfied.
Mythic UI uses automatic type/biome; no dedicated UI for selecting researched terrain T and a forced d12 result was verified.
Invalid raw target0/13/7.5 acceptance was not probed; no claim of user-visible failure or complete input validation.
owner_choices: First11/12 and pocket absorption are explicit approved behavior, docs:36-44.
Terrain automatic is explicit approved behavior, docs:8-11. Source does not prescribe growth algorithm or edge resolution.

findings.source_rule: Barriers lie on selected hex edges, ordinarily cannot be crossed; exact positioning, rounding and counting were unresolved in sheet-only extraction.
implemented: One-edge barrier has stable ID, hex+adjacent neighbor and shared physical edgeKey.
Manual add/move/remove operates on selected edge; reverse duplicate blocked; move retains identity; other records unchanged.
Both hexes must exist and be dry; river/road occupation rejected; these are product constraints, not extracted source rules.
Persistence validates actual shared edge, kingdom references and duplicate edges. Current real-App integration test verifies migration, roundtrip, edit transactions and undo/redo.
Manual road creation checks obstacle edge as blocked. Barriers display on edge from both adjacent-hex references; selected nearby list supports both sides.
partial_or_unverified: No separate ordinary-impassable attribute or travel engine was found. Road exclusion is verified source/code support, not proof of every possible runtime movement/crossing mechanic.

Multi-edge named/grouped barrier object not present; each product barrier is one edge. Source allows one or more but leaves grouping/counting undefined, so this is a product representation choice, not by itself a violation.

findings.source_rule: Typical Realm guideline: Barrier count=N total hexes/6, one or more edges, ordinarily impassable; intentional departures permitted. Rounding and multi-edge identity unspecified.
implemented: Fixed current kingdom area144 has24 individual edge barriers, numerically consistent with144/6.
Manual add/remove lets user depart from24 and save result; targeted App transaction test adds a25th barrier and confirms exact undo/redo.
absent_or_unverified: Generator hardcodes24; no generic N/6 guide, independent stored target, incomplete target state, rounding/needs-decision state or explicit intentional-departure metadata was found.
N6 andN12 pure module probes demand24 and fail for insufficient edges; N144 synthetic line gets24. This establishes a hardcoded module contract, not a supported arbitrary-Realm UI bug.
Multi-edge grouping is not defined by extracted source; cannot score segment count as grouped-object compliance without a product unit decision.
owner_choices: Current realm is fixed12x12, source does not require every product Realm be variable size.
24 weighted unique internal edges excluding water/rivers/roads is owner-specified docs:76-81.
Not an implementation defect against current spec; general Quickstart operational profile remains partial.

findings.source_rule: Four holdings at qualitative distance, typical forms include castles/walled towns/fortresses/towers; holders Knights or influential Vassals; one holding is Seat of Power.
implemented: Fresh kingdom allocation produces exactly one throne+three holding POIs, all inside designated area on settled non-tract region centers.
Seat receives same holding/bailey/keep tag policy as holding kinds, so it is semantically treated as one of the four holdings.
Insufficient settled centers prompts promotion of eligible wild regions; allocation throws if still fewer than4.
POI kinds and locations persist; real current seeded tests validate counts and map undo/redo.
Generic naming/notes/tag editing can preserve user text, but this is not dedicated holding-owner/form model.
partial_or_absent: Seat is a distinct POI kind, not an independently stored role preserving original holding form.
Changing another holding kind to throne does not atomically remove old Seat or preserve the old kind as a form; temporary real-App probe confirms two Seats persist after roundtrip.
No dedicated set-of-four selection/completeness UI or owner Knight/Vassal field was found.
No quantitative separation rule exists in source; distinct region centers are not proof of qualitative good-distance-apart. No numeric gap asserted.
owner_choices: Manual changes intentionally do not rebalance quotas or modify other objects docs67-68. Two-seat probe therefore demonstrates a source-profile role-operation gap, not a violation of approved manual behavior.
Four example forms are not mandatory unique types or a source-required closed catalogue; random choice from four forms is product design.

findings.source_rule: Six myth locations in remote places; label1..6. Research translation separates map labels from full-catalogue myth identity, allows coherent renumber and preserves links.
implemented: Initial allocation produces exactly six myth POIs within designated area, only wild regions, at most one per region.
Generation gives myth POIs automatic mb.myth tag by owner(position+region), resolving table record from d6/d12; position and record are distinct from arbitrary labels.
Current seeded kingdom tests verify six myth POIs and automatic tag existence; save map exact undo/redo works.
Relocation policy restricts Myth to wild region inside same kingdom area and disallows second Myth in destination region; persistence/tag identity checked elsewhere by parent audit.
absent_or_unverified: Map numbers1..6 and renumber operation are absent by explicit owner decision.

No source numeric remoteness threshold; one per wild region does not prove qualitative remoteness. Source does not establish a six-unique-catalogue-selection algorithm, so repeats are not called defects.
No dedicated set completeness validation after arbitrary manual edits; approved manual behavior does not automatically rebalance.
owner_choices: docs56 explicitly says six Myths without numbers. This is a documented difference from researched source, not an accidental regression.
Initial spatial/region constraints are product choices; source does not specify random placement algorithm.
d6/d12 record selector values are catalogue identity and must not be presented as missing map labels1..6.
